messages.author: 9abcbc9bb87d138d
messages.subject: RGL visualization
parts:
Dear all,

I'm having a problem with RGL visualization in R v. 4.4.2. and Geomorph v. 4.0.10. For instance, I want to visualize PCA shape changes using a warped mean shape object, with picknplot.shape function.

gps <- as.factor(paste(classifier$Dating))
PCAskullsym <- gm.prcomp(skullGPA$coords)
PCAskullplot<-plot(PCAskullsym, pch=22, cex = 1.5, bg = gps)
PCAskullplot
legend("topright", pch=22, pt.bg=unique(gps), legend = levels(gps))

picknplot.shape(PCAskullplot, method = "points", mesh=warp)

However, when I use the picknplot.shape, the rgl device gives me a blank window. 
I also tried to use this on the practice datasets (pupfish, scallops) and, again, it gives me a blank window. Unless I specify the landmark links. In that case, rgl gives me a grey line as a mean shape, and a black line as a shape deformation. 
Other visualization styles (thin plate spline, points, vectors) do not seem to work. 
I greatly appreciate any help from the hive mind. :)

All the best,
Aleksandar

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] RGL visualization
parts:
Aleksandar,

That sounds like an RGL error, not geomorph. 

I ran all of the examples from the help file of picknoplot locally, and all of them ran fine on my machine. 

I would check or reinstall all of the dependent packages, particularly RGL. 

Dean
